method.actionable: All of impact, applicability and recommendation supported. Two selected families only; extra risks do not increase recall.
method.fully_specified_validation: Supported validation requires the complete asymmetric public real Redis/worker scenario and control family. Partial proposed or model-reported checks are not zero testing and are not independently observed passes.
method.SK1: Full impact links Symbol rejection before enqueue to a persisted queued export without job ID. Outage-only orphan evidence cannot fill that boundary. Repair must preserve string-key worker decoding. Complete validation includes real worker completion, persisted job ID, exact ordered Markdown bytes and rejection queue/row state.
method.SK2: Impact is duplicate same-reader/day acceptance from truthy zero. Portable array SADD == 1, raw SADD == 1, and explicit true-or-1 acceptance are equivalent valid repairs. Scalar == 1 is not portable to baseline Boolean results. Full validation includes first/duplicate, another reader, another UTC day, enqueue-failure release, and both versions for preparatory patches.
method.layers: raw selects the actual completed recorded maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner report behind the last original delivery, including a recovered native descendant; it is not a status acknowledgment or a parent's attribution. returned_reports keeps every completed original native report and alternate visible delivery separately with identity/type/time and independent grades. final is graded on its own words, never supplemented from native reports. Authored fallback/self-analysis labels are not recorded agent types. Absent artifacts do not establish native provenance.
method.raw_normalization: Remove native hand-back framing, two harness indentation spaces per line, and trailing native agent/usage metadata only. Retain authored report text.
method.timing: wall_time_ms is request-to-settled-idle observation, including retries and spontaneous deliveries. original_evaluated_boundary preserves the earlier status-only boundary separately. recovered_native_plan_wall_time_ms retains native recovery through settled response for runs 1/3; native completion latency is separate. successful_plan_wall_time_ms requires full designated-plan delivery and remains null for run1's lossy last summary and provenance-unverified workflows. Run3 retains 808205 ms, not its waiting boundary.
method.main_vs_nested: Main traces show skill/delegation/version checks and some reads of task transcripts, not collected application experiments. Run 1 additionally performs a real locked Active Job source grep. All suites/Redis/worker results inside reports remain nested authored claims. Main transcript reads do not turn those claims into independently collected test logs.

authoritative_source_adjudications.baseline: Sidekiq 6.5.12 inherits redis-rb 4.8.1 network timeout 5 seconds.
authoritative_source_adjudications.target: Sidekiq 7.3.9 overrides redis-client default 1 second with timeout 3 seconds in redis_connection.rb.
authoritative_source_adjudications.conclusion: Effective application upgrade is 5-to-3 seconds. The redis-client internal default-to-override 1-to-3 is not the frozen Sidekiq6-to7 comparison; claims of longer enqueue failures are incorrect.
authoritative_source_adjudications.note: Check supplied by coordinator; no experiments or new source execution performed. Second run1 native report does not repeat the timeout claim.

authoritative_source_adjudications.target_call: Sidekiq 7.3.9 scheduled.rb calls ConnectionPool::TimedStack#pop with positional total/random_poll_interval.
authoritative_source_adjudications.incompatible_dependency: connection_pool 3 takes keyword timeout. Sidekiq 7.3.9 gemspec only requires >=2.3.0, with no upper-bound protection.
authoritative_source_adjudications.conclusion: A resolve can admit 3.x and break scheduler promotion of reminders/retries. Require a compatible 2.x constraint (<3) or an independently verified scheduler-compatible repair; preserving an old lock value informally does not protect a relock.
authoritative_source_adjudications.note: Separate additional risk, not a third selected family. Both run1 native originals lack this protection.

authoritative_source_adjudications.conclusion: Redis::BaseError no longer catching RedisClient errors is real, but broad cleanup is not automatically safe. Limit cleanup/rescue to enqueue; successful push followed by export.update! failure must not destroy the export backing the live queued job.
